name: PLUS
verdict: A division at Hanwha Life, a Korea Exchange-listed insurer whose largest shareholder is Hanwha Corporation (43.24%). Nothing found.
note: Multi-year founding partner of Korean Golf Club, described by LIV Golf (May 2026) as 'a division at Hanwha Life'; the exact brand entity within Hanwha is unclear (Hanwha Life operates the LIFEPLUS brand at lifeplus.co.kr). Hanwha Life's shareholder list includes state agency Korea Deposit Insurance Corporation (10%); per METHOD.md a South Korean public holder is not a link to abuse. Quick company check (2026-10-03): no court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against Hanwha Life or Hanwha Group found.
